name: Resonant Quantum Mechanics
identity: RQM Technologies LLC provides quantum circuit preparation, bounded circuit assurance, local simulation, and an authenticated path to supported physical QPU experiments through Amazon Braket. Hardware execution requires current device eligibility, a fresh exact quote, prepaid RQM credits and owner-approved spending authority.
research: RQM's public mathematical work includes quaternion algebra, spinors, Bloch geometry, SU(2), and Quaternionic Spectral Geometry. Unit quaternions and complete SU(2) matrices encode the same single-rotation information. Any claimed software advantage requires evidence against equivalent baselines.

examples.label: Check before compilation
examples.goal: Assess a small OpenQASM 3 program before downstream compilation.
examples.interpretation: Inspect the returned go, no_go, or unsupported outcome, normalized source, warnings, and evidence. A go verdict applies only within the documented verifier scope; it is not hardware readiness.

examples.label: Optimize with preservation
examples.goal: Ask for a smaller circuit while retaining the original unless preservation is verified.
examples.interpretation: Inspect outcome, candidate_withheld, fallback_status, original_hash, returned_hash, circuit, and report. Adopt a candidate only when the completed result verifies preservation. A fallback or unsupported result is not a verified optimization.

examples.label: Inspect simulated outcomes
examples.goal: Simulate a one-qubit circuit with a Hadamard operation and Z measurement.
examples.interpretation: Inspect typed counts, probabilities, job status, and simulation configuration. Sampling may vary. This is bounded local statevector simulation, with no remote provider or physical QPU execution.
